name: autonomous-world
description: Autonomous World - An infinitely running autonomous simulation game

command: import subprocess,sys; raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(sys.argv[1:], stdin=sys.stdin, stdout=sys.stdout, stderr=sys.stderr, creationflags=0x08000000))

imports.description: Use @/* path alias for imports from src/ directory

prisma.note: Prisma 7 requires prisma.config.ts at project root. Do NOT include url in schema.prisma datasource block.

auth.pattern: Use auth() function, not getSession(). Export { GET, POST } from handlers.
